note: the grandchild (new session, escaped pgroup) still talks to the SAME loopback marker/sink, so marker_read and outbound_post are expected to fire. pgroup_escape WAS a real, disclosed, undetected gap (no detector produced FindingKind.pgroup_escape); fixed by detectors/pgroup_escape.py, fed by ProcWatcher's escape/exit distinction and MarkerRead/OutboundPost.peer_escaped (resolved synchronously by the listeners at connection time, since this scenario's escaped process is short-lived enough to race past a poll-only check). This fixture is now a regression test for the fix, kept at its original name/directory for git history traceability. The fresh, structurally distinct holdout proving the detector generalizes (not just pattern-matches this one scenario) is escape_relay — see docs/NUMBERS.md.
